title: Qualities Loved by Allah
english_text:
Qualities Loved by Allah

https://www.khutbah.info/qualities-loved-by-allah/ The full moon is missed during a dark night. And shade is sought and refreshing breezes are coveted when the sun blazes with scorching heat. How wonderful is justice when injustice prevails, and fairness when wrongdoing abounds. And how amazing are those in the prime of their youths who triumph over their overwhelming desires. And what great fortune and abundant success is attained by those perpetually attaching their hearts to every masjed.

إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ ,نَحْمَدُهُ ,وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ , وَنَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا ,مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ , وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ , وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ

Verily, all praise is for Allah. We praise Him, we seek His assistance and we ask for His forgiveness. And we seek refuge in Him from the evils of our selves. Whoever Allah guides, none can misguide. Whoever He misguides, none can guide. And I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

يَا أَيُّهَا الّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ آل عمران:102

Al Imran 102 : O you who believe! Fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except in a state of Islam.

Oh people:

The full moon is missed during a dark night. And shade is sought and refreshing breezes are coveted when the sun blazes with scorching heat. How wonderful is justice when injustice prevails, and fairness when wrongdoing abounds.

And how amazing are those in the prime of their youths who triumph over their overwhelming desires. And what great fortune and abundant success is attained by those perpetually attaching their hearts to every masjed.

And how blessed are two men who love each other for the sake of Allah, who do not meet except for His sake, and do not part except for His sake.

And how wonderful are chastity and fear of Allah when temptations appear and obstacles diminish. How beneficial is the charity given secretly in extinguishing the wrath of the Lord. And how sweet are tears flowing in seclusion, streaming down the cheeks of the remorseful and repentant to their Lord.

Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى في ظِلِّهِ يَومَ لا ظِلَّ إلَّا ظِلُّهُ: إمَامٌ عَدْلٌ، وشَابٌّ نَشَأَ في عِبَادَةِ اللَّهِ، ورَجُلٌ قَلْبُهُ مُعَلَّقٌ في المَسَاجِدِ، ورَجُلَانِ تَحَابَّا في اللَّهِ ، اجْتَمعا عليه وتَفَرَّقَا عليه، ورَجُلٌ دَعَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ ذَاتُ مَنْصِبٍ وجَمَالٍ فَقالَ: إنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ، ورَجُلٌ تَصَدَّقَ بصَدَقَةٍ فأخْفَاهَا حتَّى لا تَعْلَمَ شِمَالُهُ ما تُنْفِقُ يَمِينُهُ، ورَجُلٌ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ خَالِيًا، فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ

There are seven whom Allah will shade in His shade on the Day when there is no shade but His: a just ruler; a young man who grew up in the worship of Allah; a man whose heart is attached to the mosques; two men who love each other for the sake of Allah, meeting for that and parting upon that; a man who is called by a woman of status and beauty but he says, ‘ Indeed, I fear Allah ’ ; a man who gives in charity and hides it so that his left hand does not know what his right hand has spent; and a man who remembers Allah in seclusion, and his eyes overflow with tears. [Bukhari 1423, Muslim 1031]

How desperately we all need to be shaded by the shade of the Most Merciful, on a difficult day in which the affliction is great and the distress is severe. On the day when the sun draws near to creation, until it is only a mile away from them.

In every era and every land, how great is the virtue of the just leader, the one entrusted with authority. That is, everyone who is given responsibility over the affairs of the Muslims and acts justly therein.

The just authority is the one who follows the command of Allah by placing everything in its proper place, without excess or negligence. He is like a father to the people, and they are like his children, teaching the ignorant, comforting the poor, and treating the sick. He sees the strong as weak until he takes what is due upon them, and sees the weak as noble until he restores what is due to them.

When ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz assumed the Caliphate, he sent a message to al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī requesting him to describe the just authority to him. So among what al-Ḥasan wrote to him was: Know, O Commander of the Faithful, that Allah has made the just authority the one who straightens every crookedness, a means to correct every injustice. He is like the compassionate shepherd toward his camels, who searches for the best pastures for them. He is like the kind merciful mother towards her child. He is like the heart among the limbs, if it is sound, the limbs are sound, and if it is corrupt, the limbs are corrupt.

O Allah, shade us under Your shade on the Day when there is no shade but Your shade.

The young Muslim who deserves to be one of these seven is the youth, who has not yet grown old, whose heart is attached to his Lord. Repelling the pitfalls of psychological desires and the passions of the body.

Allah Almighty said:

وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ

Taha (20), 131: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

The youth are prone in this stage to all types of unstable behavior, and more likely to fall prey to dangerous pitfalls.

Youth is one of the most risky phases of life, for it is a period of strength between two weaknesses, the weakness of childhood and the weakness of old age.

And people will be questioned as to how they spent their youth. For the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

لا تزولَ قَدَمُ ابنِ آدمٍ بينَ يَدِيِ ربِّهِ عزَّ وجَلَّ يومَ القِيَامَةِ حتَّى يُسألَ عن خمسِ خصالٍ عُمُرِهِ فيمَا أَفْنَاهُ و عن شبابِهِ فيما أبلاهُ

The son of Adam’s feet will not move on the Day of Resurrection until he is asked about five things, about his life and how he spent it, about his youth and how he used it.. [Sahih at-Targhib (128), Graded: Hasan li-ghayrihi]

O Allah, shade us under Your shade on the Day when there is no shade but Your shade.

Masjeds are the houses of Allah. And the places of worshipping Him and the best spots on earth. Allah honors those who frequent Masjeds and visit them, and He rewards for the steps taken towards them.

Allah Almighty said:

فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ * رِجَالٌ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصَارُ

An-Nur (24) 36–37: (36) [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which Allāh has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned [i.e., praised] therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings (37) [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about

Almighty Allah rejoices over the visitors of the masjeds. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

مَا تَوَطَّنَ رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلصَّلاَةِ وَالذِّكْرِ إِلاَّ تَبَشْبَشَ اللَّهُ لَهُ كَمَا يَتَبَشْبَشُ أَهْلُ الْغَائِبِ بِغَائِبِهِمْ إِذَا قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِمْ

A muslim does not regularly attend the mosques to perform prayer and remember Allah, but Allah feels happy with him just as the family of one who is absent feels happy when he comes back to them. [Sunan Ibn Majah 800, Grade: Sahih]

O Allah, shade us under Your shade on the Day when there is no shade but Your shade.

Believers in this life find it extremely difficult to live alone and isolated, without a friend or companion, someone they can confide in, share their joy, and support them during hardship and comfort them.

The relationships of many people in this day and age have become shallow and flawed, they are established and sustained for some worldly benefits and gains.

Indeed Islam is the religion of brotherhood, love, and unity. Allah Almighty said:

وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ

Al-Anfal (8) 63: And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allāh brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise.

Love and hatred for the sake of Allah are among the strongest bonds of faith, and through them, hearts are brought together.

Those who love each other for the sake of Allah have lasting companionship and enduring affection that only strengthens with time.

Allah Almighty said:

الْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ

Az-Zukhruf (43) 67: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous.

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

إِنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ لأُنَاسًا مَا هُمْ بِأَنْبِيَاءَ وَلاَ شُهَدَاءَ يَغْبِطُهُمُ الأَنْبِيَاءُ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِمَكَانِهِمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُخْبِرُنَا مَنْ هُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏‏ هُمْ قَوْمٌ تَحَابُّوا بِرُوحِ اللَّهِ عَلَى غَيْرِ أَرْحَامٍ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلاَ أَمْوَالٍ يَتَعَاطَوْنَهَا فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّ وُجُوهَهُمْ لَنُورٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ عَلَى نُورٍ لاَ يَخَافُونَ إِذَا خَافَ النَّاسُ وَلاَ يَحْزَنُونَ إِذَا حَزِنَ النَّاسُ ‏ ‏ ‏.‏ وَقَرَأَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏ ‏ أَلاَ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

Indeed, among the servants of Allah are people who are neither prophets nor martyrs, yet the prophets and martyrs will envy them on the Day of Resurrection because of their rank with Allah, the Exalted. They said, O Messenger of Allah, tell us who they are He said: They are people who love one another for the sake of Allah, without there being family ties between them and without exchanging wealth between them. By Allah, their faces will be light, and they will be upon (pulpits of) light. They will not fear when the people are afraid, and they will not grieve when the people grieve. Then he recited the verse: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.' [Sunan Abi Dawud 3527, Grade: Sahih (Albani)]

O Allah, shade us under Your shade on the Day when there is no shade but Your shade.

When the paths of temptation are opened, and the calls and allurements to sin surround someone, they are in desperate need to witness the proofs of their Lord and for the light of guidance to shine within their heart.

There is no trial more severe than the one in which a man overcomes his passion and instincts. When a beautiful woman of high status offers herself to him, while he is in the prime of his manhood.

In such a situation, a man should not despair. For fear and watchfulness of his Lord remind him of what Allah Almighty said about Yusuf, peace be upon him:

وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ

Yusuf (12) 23: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him.

Indeed, many factors were present that could have led Yusuf (peace be upon him) to commit indecency. He was young and youth has its temptations.

وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ ۖ وَهَمَّ بِهَا

Yusuf (12) 24: She advanced towards him, and he would have done likewise…

And she locked the doors. She was the lady of the house and knew well the timings and what was possible when. So what happened then?

قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ

Yusuf (12) 23: He said, [I seek] the refuge of Allāh. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed.

In this was seeking refuge in Allah, purification, and abhorrence of sin. What was the reason? Because he worshiped Allah as though he saw Him, and so Allah showed him the proof of his Lord.

Allah Almighty said:

وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ ﴿٤٠﴾ فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ ﴿٤١﴾

An-Nazi’at (79), 40–41: (40) But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination, (41) Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge. So fear Allah, and adopt the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and follow his guidance, you will succeed. And the promise will be fulfilled for you, to be shaded under the shade of the Most Merciful on the Day when there is no shade but His.

أَقُولُ مَا تَسْمَعُونَ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ لِي وَلَكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

I say what you have heard and I seek forgiveness from Allah for me and you from every sin. So seek forgives from Him, Verily He is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

Second Khutbah

الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ , وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَاْ إِلَهَ إِلَّاْ اَللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَاْشَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَاً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ

All praise is to Allah, and peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah, and I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

Oh Muslims:

And know that among the people are those upon whom Allah has bestowed wealth, and they do not deny the bounty of Allah upon them. Rather, they spend generously, and they give discretely to the poor, knowing that among the needy are those who are embarrassed by being given openly .

Such a man has overcome the obstacle of greed. Allah has rescued him from being among those who worship wealth. For the lovers of wealth have chained themselves with the shackles of miserliness and withholding, sentencing themselves to live sick despite their health, poor despite their wealth and occupied despite their free time. And they are unaware of the saying of the Prophet ﷺ:

الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى

The upper hand is better than the lower hand. [Bukhari 1429 and Muslim 1033]

Indeed, the human soul by nature inclines toward showing off its deeds, especially acts of charity, in order to be praised.

So if someone strives against their soul in this regard, they becomes deserving of being among the seven whom Allah will shade under His shade on the Day when there is no shade but His.

How blissful are the moments when a person sits alone with themselves, calling upon their Lord and Creator, and their tears flow, sweet and pure, untainted by the pollution of showing off.

Indeed, the fires of sin that strike a believer’s heart igniting it into a burning charcoal, can only be extinguished by those tears. Tears that flow as a result of remembering the Creator and fearing Him.

Indeed, Ibn Sīrīn used to laugh during the day, but when night would fall, he would weep as if he had slain the entire village.

So fear Allah. And know that there must be fear and weeping, either in the avenue of worship and devotion, or in the abyss of banishment and rejection.

Either you burn your heart, with the fire of tears over your shortcomings, or know that the fire of Hell is far more intense. Allah Almighty said:

فَلْيَضْحَكُوا قَلِيلًا وَلْيَبْكُوا كَثِيرًا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

At-Tawbah (9) 82: So let them laugh a little and [then] weep much as recompense for what they used to earn.

So look, at those who weep in seclusion, they have settled on the shores of their rivers of tears. If you were to walk just a few steps away from your desires, you would see their tents appear before you and hear their weeping and sobbing.

O Allah, shade us under Your shade on the Day when there is no shade but Your shade. Indeed Allah is All Hearing, Answering.

هَذَا وَصَلُّوا وَسَلِّمُوا عَلَى نَبِيِّكُم كَمَا أَمَرَكُمْ بِذلِكَ رَبُّكُمْ , فَقَالَ

I conclude with this and send prayers of blessings and peace upon your Prophet as your Lord commanded:

إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا

Al Ahzaab (33) 56: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [ Allah to grant him] peace.

اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنا فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنا فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنا فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لنا فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنا شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ وَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ

O Allah, guide us with those whom You have guided, grant us well-being among those You have granted well-being, be an ally to us along with those whom You are an ally to, and bless what You have bestowed upon us, and save us from the evil of what You have decreed. For verily You decree and none can decree over You. He whom You support can never be humiliated. Glory is to You, our Lord, You are Blessed and Exalted.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْنا مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْنا مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَنَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لَنا خَيْرًا

O Allah, We ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet has asked You for, and we seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, we ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and we seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And we ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning us good

عِبَادَ اللّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

Servants of Allah. Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

اُذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ يَذْكُرْكُمْ واشْكُرُوهُ يَزِدْكُمْ واسْتَغْفِرُوهُ يَغْفِرْ لكُمْ واتّقُوهُ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَمْرِكُمْ مَخْرَجًا وَأَقِمِ الصّلَاة

Remember Allah, the Great He will remember you. Thank Him for His favors He will increase you therein. And seek forgiveness from Him He will forgive you. And be conscious of Him He will provide you a way out of difficult matters. And, establish the prayer.

title: The Virtue of Remembrance
english_text:
The Virtue of Remembrance

https://www.khutbah.info/the-virtue-of-remembrance/ Indeed, the purest of deeds, the best of characteristics, and the most beloved to Allah—the Possessor of Majesty—is the remembrance of Allah, the Exalted. Al-Tirmidhi and others narrated from Abu al-Darda (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Shall I not inform you of the best of your deeds, and the purest of them with your Master, and the highest of them in your ranks, and better for you than giving away gold and silver, and better for you than meeting your adversary and striking their collars and them striking yours? They said, Yes, O Messenger of Allah! He said: The remembrance of Allah, the Exalted. [Sahih Tirmithi 3377, Grade: Sahih (Albani)]

إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ ,نَحْمَدُهُ ,وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ , وَنَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا ,مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ , وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ , وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ

Verily, all praise is for Allah. We praise Him, we seek His assistance and we ask for His forgiveness. And we seek refuge in Him from the evils of our selves. Whoever Allah guides, none can misguide. Whoever He misguides, none can guide. And I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

يَا أَيُّهَا الّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ آل عمران:102

Al Imran 102 : O you who believe! Fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except in a state of Islam.

Oh people:

Indeed, the purest of deeds, the best of characteristics, and the most beloved to Allah—the Possessor of Majesty—is the remembrance of Allah, the Exalted. Al-Tirmidhi and others narrated from Abu al-Darda (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَعْمَالِكُمْ وَأَزْكَاهَا عِندَ مَلِيكِكُمْ وَأَرْفَعِهَا فِي دَرَجَاتِكُمْ، وَخَيْرٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ إِنْفَاقِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ وَخَيْرٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْ تَلْقَوْا عَدُوَّكُمْ فَتَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَهُمْ وَيَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَكُمْ؟ قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ قَالَ ذِكْرُ اللهِ تَعَالَى

Shall I not inform you of the best of your deeds, and the purest of them with your Master, and the highest of them in your ranks, and better for you than giving away gold and silver, and better for you than meeting your adversary and striking their collars and them striking yours? They said, Yes, O Messenger of Allah! He said: The remembrance of Allah, the Exalted. [Sahih Tirmithi 3377, Grade: Sahih (Albani)]

Those who remember Allah, the Exalted, are the forerunners in the journey toward Allah and the eternal home of the Hereafter. It is narrated from Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet ﷺ said:

سَبَقَ الْمُفَرِّدُونَ قَالُوا وَمَا الْمُفَرِّدُونَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ الذَّاكِرُونَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتُ

The Mufarridun have outpaced (others)! They said, “O Messenger of Allah, who are the Mufarridun? He said, Those men and women who remember Allah much. [Muslim 2676]

These, are the ones for whom Allah has prepared a noble status and a tremendous reward. Allah Almighty said:

وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيراً وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْراً عَظِيماً

Al-Ahzab (33) 35: And the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.

The remembrance of Allah, is the life of the hearts. There is no life for hearts except through it. It is narrated in Sahih al-Bukhari from Abu Musa al-Ashʿari (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet ﷺ said:

مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ

The example of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not remember his Lord is like the example of the living and the dead. [ Bukhari 6407]

The heart will never find peace, tranquility, joy, delight, or happiness except through the remembrance of Allah, the Exalted. Allah Almighty said:

الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُمْ بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ

Ar-Raʿd (13) 28: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured.

The remembrance of Allah, the Exalted, is relief after hardship, ease after difficulty, solace after distress and worry. In it is the removal of afflictions, the facilitation of matters, and the realization of comfort and happiness in both this world and the Hereafter. There is no affliction alleviated and no hardship removed by anything better than the remembrance of Allah—Blessed and Exalted is He. Our Prophet ﷺused to say in times of distress:

لَا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظـيمُ الْحَلِـيمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَـرْشِ العَظِيـمِ لَا إِلَـهَ إِلَّا اللَّهْ رَبُّ السَّمَـوّاتِ ورّبُّ الأَرْضِ ورَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَـريم

There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne. [Bukhari 6346, Muslim 2730a]

And he ﷺ said:

دَعْوَةُ ذِي النُّونِ إِذْ دَعَا وَهُوَ فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَدْعُ بِهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ فِي شَيْءٍ قَطُّ إِلاَّ اسْتَجَابَ اللَّهُ لَهُ

The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Yunus) when he supplicated, while in the belly of the whale was: ‘There is none worthy of worship except You, Glory to You, Indeed, I have been of the transgressors. So indeed, no Muslim man supplicates with it for anything, ever, except Allah responds to him. [Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3505, Grade: Sahih]

The remembrance of Allah, brings back lost blessings and preserves existing ones. There is no means by which blessings are acquired or safeguarded better than the remembrance of Allah—Blessed and Exalted is He. Allah Almighty said:

وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ وَلَئِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ

Ibrahim (14) 7: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'

The remembrance of Allah—Glorified and Exalted—is a remover of burdens, an expiation for sins, a means of elevation in ranks, and a path to high status in the sight of Allah—Blessed and Exalted is He. There is nothing that removes burdens like His remembrance.

Al-Tirmidhi narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said:

مَا شَيْءٌ أَنْجَى مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ

There is nothing that brings more salvation from the punishment of Allah than the remembrance of Allah. [Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3377, Grade: Hassan]

It is also authentically reported from him ﷺ that he said:

مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ‏ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ

Whoever says: ‘Subḥān Allāh wa biḥamdih’ (Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him) one hundred times, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as much as the foam of the sea. [Bukhari 6405, Muslim 2691]

There are many Hadiths with this same meaning.

The remembrance of Allah, the Exalted, is the cultivation of Paradise. There is nothing by which Paradise is cultivated like the remembrance of Him Almighty.

The Prophet ﷺ said:

مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ

Whoever says Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He will have a date palm planted for him in Paradise. [Tirmithi 3465, Grade: Sahih (Albani)]

Al-Tirmidhi also narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said:

لَقيتُ إبراهيمَ ليلةَ أُسْريَ بي فقالَ يا محمَّدُ أقرئ أمَّتَكَ منِّي السَّلامَ وأخبِرْهُم أنَّ الجنَّةَ طيِّبةُ التُّربةِ عذبةُ الماءِ وأنَّها قيعانٌ وأنَّ غِراسَها سُبحانَ اللَّهِ والحمدُ للَّهِ ولا إلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ واللَّهُ أَكْبرُ

I met Ibrahim, the Khalil (Beloved) of Allah, the night I was taken on the Night Journey, and he said to me: ‘O Muhammad, convey my greetings to your Ummah, and tell them that Paradise has good soil and sweet water, and that it is a flat plain, and its vegetation is: Subḥān Allāh (Glory be to Allah), Al-ḥamdu lillāh (Praise be to Allah), Lā ilāha illa Allāh (There is no god but Allah), and Allāhu akbar (Allah is the Greatest). [Tirmidhi 3462, Grade: Hassan (Albani)]

The remembrance of Allah, consists of words that are light upon the tongue and uttered with minimal effort and without hardship—but they carry immense reward and great recompense and are beloved to Allah—Mighty and Majestic.

The Prophet ﷺ said:

كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

Two words, light on the tongue, heavy in the balance, beloved to the Most Merciful: Subḥān Allāh wa biḥamdih, Subḥān Allāh al-‘Aẓīm (Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, Glory be to Allah the Almighty). [Bukhari, 6682 Muslim 2694]

The remembrance of Allah—Glorified and Exalted—repels the devils. It saves from their whispers, their evil, their plots, and their traps. Allah Almighty said:

وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

Fussilat (41) 36: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

Allah Almighty also said:

وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ

Al-Mu’minun (23) 97–98: ( 97) And say, ‘My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils. (98) And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.’

Allah Almighty also said:

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَائِفٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ تَذَكَّرُوا فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْصِرُونَ

Al-A’raf (7) 201: Indeed, those who fear Allāh when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight.

Allah Almighty also said:

وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَاناً فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ

Az-Zukhruf (43) 36: And whoever is blinded from the remembrance of the Most Merciful—We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

The fruits of remembrance and the benefits that it brings are countless and innumerable. I advise myself and you to read the book Al-Wabil As-Sayyib min al-Kalim At-Tayyib by the scholar Ibn al-Qayyim al-Jawziyyah (may Allah have mercy on him). In it, he—may Allah have mercy on him—enumerates more than seventy great benefits of the remembrance of Allah—Blessed and Exalted be He.

When one reflects upon these immense benefits, their desire to maintain the remembrance of Allah will increase, and their eagerness to uphold it will grow.

أَقُولُ مَا تَسْمَعُونَ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ لِي وَلَكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

I say what you have heard and I seek forgiveness from Allah for me and you from every sin. So seek forgives from Him, Verily He is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

Second Khutbah

الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ , وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَاْ إِلَهَ إِلَّاْ اَللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَاْشَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَاً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ

All praise is to Allah, and peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah, and I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

Oh Muslims:

Indeed, there are many Quranic verses and numerous authentic Hadiths of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ urging the remembrance of Allah, commanding it in abundance and clarifying the reward for those who frequently remember Allah.

Allah, the Exalted, says:

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا ۝ وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا ۝ هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا

Al-Ahzab (33) 41–43: (41) O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance. (42) And exalt Him morning and afternoon. (43) It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.

Ibn ʿAbbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: If you do that, that is remember Allah abundantly, then He and His angels will send blessings upon you.

And Allah the Most High says:

وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

Al-Ahzab (33) 35: And the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.

And Allah the Most High says:

وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

Al-Anfal (8) 45: And remember Allah much that you may succeed.

And there are many more verses and Hadiths urging frequent remembrance of Allah and commanding it abundantly.

The scholars have stated in the books of tafsir and the commentaries on Hadith that if a Muslim is consistent in the morning and evening remembrances, the remembrances after the obligatory prayers, the remembrances before sleep, the remembrances when entering and exiting the home, when riding, when eating and drinking, and after completing meals, along with maintaining general (unrestricted) remembrance throughout the day and night then he or she is written among those men and women who remember Allah much, about whom Allah said:

وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

Al-Ahzab (33) 35: And the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward. May Allah make us all among those who remember Him often, uphold His obedience and worship Him sincerely. Indeed Allah is All Hearing, Answering.

هَذَا وَصَلُّوا وَسَلِّمُوا عَلَى نَبِيِّكُم كَمَا أَمَرَكُمْ بِذلِكَ رَبُّكُمْ , فَقَالَ

I conclude with this and send prayers of blessings and peace upon your Prophet as your Lord commanded:

إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا

Al Ahzaab (33) 56: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [ Allah to grant him] peace.

اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنا فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنا فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنا فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لنا فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنا شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ وَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ

O Allah, guide us with those whom You have guided, grant us well-being among those You have granted well-being, be an ally to us along with those whom You are an ally to, and bless what You have bestowed upon us, and save us from the evil of what You have decreed. For verily You decree and none can decree over You. He whom You support can never be humiliated. Glory is to You, our Lord, You are Blessed and Exalted.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْنا مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْنا مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَنَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لَنا خَيْرًا

O Allah, We ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet has asked You for, and we seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, we ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and we seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And we ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning us good

عِبَادَ اللّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

Servants of Allah. Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

اُذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ يَذْكُرْكُمْ واشْكُرُوهُ يَزِدْكُمْ واسْتَغْفِرُوهُ يَغْفِرْ لكُمْ واتّقُوهُ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَمْرِكُمْ مَخْرَجًا وَأَقِمِ الصّلَاة

Remember Allah, the Great He will remember you. Thank Him for His favors He will increase you therein. And seek forgiveness from Him He will forgive you. And be conscious of Him He will provide you a way out of difficult matters. And, establish the prayer.

title: Causes of Heedlessness
english_text:
Causes of Heedlessness

https://www.khutbah.info/causes-of-heedlessness/ A person’s affairs, in this world and the next, are not sound except through the soundness of their heart, adherence to the commands of Allah the Most High, and diligence and effort in obeying Him Almighty. The disease of heedlessness is one of the diseases that destroys hearts, distances people from righteous deeds, and diverts them from what benefits them to what harms them. People vary in their heedlessness. Among them are those whose hearts are completely overcome by heedlessness, knowing nothing but this worldly life, working only for it, and believing that there is nothing beyond it. This is the behavior of the disbelievers and the hypocrites.

إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ ,نَحْمَدُهُ ,وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ , وَنَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا ,مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ , وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ , وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ

Verily, all praise is for Allah. We praise Him, we seek His assistance and we ask for His forgiveness. And we seek refuge in Him from the evils of our selves. Whoever Allah guides, none can misguide. Whoever He misguides, none can guide. And I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

يَا أَيُّهَا الّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ آل عمران:102

Al Imran 102 : O you who believe! Fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except in a state of Islam.

Oh people:

A person’s affairs, in this world and the next, are not sound except through the soundness of their heart, adherence to the commands of Allah the Most High, and diligence and effort in obeying Him Almighty. The disease of heedlessness is one of the diseases that destroys hearts, distances people from righteous deeds, and diverts them from what benefits them to what harms them. People vary in their heedlessness. Among them are those whose hearts are completely overcome by heedlessness, knowing nothing but this worldly life, working only for it, and believing that there is nothing beyond it. This is the behavior of the disbelievers and the hypocrites.

Among the people of faith are those who are heedless due to their engagement with worldly diversions and preoccupation with them, some experiencing much and others little. No one is entirely free from some form of heedlessness, yet believers awaken and become aware of their heedlessness.

In the authentic Hadith, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said:

لِكُلِّ عَمَلٍ شِرَّةٌ وَلِكُلِّ شِرَّةٍ فَتْرَةٌ فَمَنْ كَانَتْ فَتْرَتُهُ إِلَى سُنَّتِي فَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ وَمَنْ كَانَتْ إِلَى غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ هَلَكَ-رواه أحمد

Every deed has a period of enthusiasm, and every enthusiasm is followed by a slackening. Whoever’s slackening is towards my Sunnah has succeeded, and whoever’s slackening leads elsewhere will perish. [Ahmad 6958, Grade: Sound chain (Arnaout)]

There are numerous causes for heedlessness, the gravest of which is disbelief. A disbeliever is in complete heedlessness about their ultimate fate in the Hereafter, only caring for this worldly life and its fleeting pleasures. Allah Almighty clarifies their heedlessness in His Book:

يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ الْآخِرَةِ هُمْ غَافِلُونَ * أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَافِرُونَ

Ar-Rum (30) 7-8: (7) They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware. (8) Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.

Allah Almighty also says:

لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أُنْذِرَ آبَاؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ * لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

Ya-Sin (36) 6-7: (6) That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware. (7) Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

Another cause of heedlessness is being deceived by this worldly life, becoming attached to it, and striving solely for it. Those whose hearts are attached to the worldly life, accumulating it, enjoying it, and being greedy for it, forget the Hereafter to the extent of their attachment. That is why it was said, “Love of this worldly life is the root of every sin.” Because this worldly life deceives people, Allah has repeatedly warned about it in many verses. Allah Almighty says:

وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

Al-An’am (6) 32: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?

Allah Almighty also says:

وَمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

Al-Ankabut (29) 64: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.

Allah Almighty also says:

إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ

Luqman (31) 33: Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

Allah Almighty also says:

يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ * إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا إِنَّمَا يَدْعُو حِزْبَهُ لِيَكُونُوا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ

Fatir (35) 5-6: (5) O mankind, indeed the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan]. (6) Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.

Among the causes of heedlessness is turning away the Quran. Allah Almighty says:

كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ * بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

Fussilat (41) 3-4: (3) A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who know, (4) As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

So whoever turns away from the Quran will be afflicted with heedlessness. Because the Quran is a book of knowledge, admonition, and reminder.

Likewise, heedlessness is caused by turning away from contemplating Allah Almighty’s signs in this existence. For signs of Allah Almighty’s greatness are found throughout the universe. Whoever turns away from noticing and contemplating them will be afflicted with heedlessness of knowing their Lord, glory be to Him, the Most High. Allah Almighty says:

وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ آيَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا ‌مُعْرِضُونَ * وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُمْ مُشْرِكُونَ-يُوسُفَ 105-106

Yusuf (12) 105-106: (105) And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away. (106) And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.

Likewise, is turning away from thinking about the beginning and the end, death and the reckoning, causes one to become heedless. Because they become distracted by this worldly life and forget what awaits them in the Hereafter:

اقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ ‌مُعْرِضُونَ * مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ * لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ-الْأَنْبِيَاءِ 1-3

Al-Anbiya (21) 1-3: (1) [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away. (2) No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play (3) With their hearts distracted.

Likewise, turning away from learning the religion of Allah Almighty causes one to become ignorant, and become heedless because of their ignorance.

بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ الْحَقَّ فَهُمْ ‌مُعْرِضُونَ-الْأَنْبِيَاءِ 24

Al-Anbiya (21) 24: But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.

When a man turned away from the Prophet’s teaching, the Prophet said:

وَأَمَّا الْآخَرُ فَأَعْرَضَ فَأَعْرَضَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ

As for the other man, he turned away, so Allah turned away from him. [Bukhari 474, Muslim 2176a]

And the religion of Allah, the Most High, is great cannot be attained by the one who turns away or is arrogant.

One of the causes of heedlessness is not rejoicing in the Quran, because it is a book of admonition, reminder, nourishment for the hearts, and a cure for their ailments.

يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ * قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ-يُونُسَ 57- 58

Yunus (10) 57-58: (57) O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers. (58) Say, In the bounty of Allāh and in His mercy in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate.

Among the signs of rejoicing in the Quran is frequently reciting it, contemplating it, and memorizing it.

So it is no wonder that heedlessness befalls the one who turns away from the Quran, due to their distance from the Quran, which is the life and healing of the hearts.

أَقُولُ مَا تَسْمَعُونَ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ لِي وَلَكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

I say what you have heard and I seek forgiveness from Allah for me and you from every sin. So seek forgives from Him, Verily He is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

Second Khutbah

الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ , وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَاْ إِلَهَ إِلَّاْ اَللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَاْشَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَاً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ

All praise is to Allah, and peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah, and I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

Oh Muslims:

Be conscious of Allah, the Most High, and obey Him, and beware of heedlessness, for it extinguishes the heart and leading one into darkness. Allah Almighty says:

أَوَمَنْ كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَاهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُورًا يَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ كَمَنْ مَثَلُهُ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِنْهَا كَذَلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

Al-An’am (6) 122: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing.

In our times, a wide door of social media has opened for people, robbing their time, distracting them from the beneficial, and leading them to neglect their prayers and religious duties.

Social media has brought those far away closer and facilitated interaction among people, despite their geographical, cultural and national differences. Engaging excessively with social media is a cause of heedlessness. How much worse is it if it involves the forbidden—such as a man communicating with a woman who is not lawful for him or a woman communicating with a man who is not lawful for her—and perhaps even doing so publicly for all to see? This inevitably leads to heedlessness.

Some people indulge in these media, watching them, and switching from one program to another, or from one page to another. Long hours pass without them even realizing it, and they may even neglect the interests of their family and household, and the duties of their Lord, Glory be to Him.

All of this stems from heedlessness and increases in heedlessness. Allah Almighty has commanded to keep company with the righteous to awaken hearts from their heedlessness. He has also forbidden obedience to idle people who increase one in heedlessness. He, glory be to Him, says:

وَاصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُ فُرُطًا

Al-Kahf (18) 28: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His face [i.e., acceptance]. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.

So what about those who spend long hours on trivial diversions and tasteless discussions, most of which involve transgressions and sins that they burden themselves with without even realizing it? How extreme is their negligence! And how great is the disregard many people have for forbidden things! How great their loss will be if they do not return to their senses and repent from their sins!!

Thus, it is incumbent upon believers to avoid the causes of heedlessness and pay attention to the life of their hearts by strengthening their faith, reciting the Quran, and performing righteous deeds. Indeed, drawing closer to Allah Almighty is achieved by the purity of the heart and righteous deeds. As the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said:

إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ

Indeed, Allah does not look at your appearances or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds. [Muslim 2564c]

We ask Allah make us among those who remember Him Almighty while standing, sitting and on our sides. Indeed Allah is All Hearing, Answering.

هَذَا وَصَلُّوا وَسَلِّمُوا عَلَى نَبِيِّكُم كَمَا أَمَرَكُمْ بِذلِكَ رَبُّكُمْ , فَقَالَ

I conclude with this and send prayers of blessings and peace upon your Prophet as your Lord commanded:

إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا

Al Ahzaab (33) 56: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [ Allah to grant him] peace.

O Allah, guide us with those whom You have guided, grant us well-being among those You have granted well-being, be an ally to us along with those whom You are an ally to, and bless what You have bestowed upon us, and save us from the evil of what You have decreed. For verily You decree and none can decree over You. He whom You support can never be humiliated. Glory is to You, our Lord, You are Blessed and Exalted.

O Allah, We ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet has asked You for, and we seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, we ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and we seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And we ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning us good

عِبَادَ اللّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

Servants of Allah. Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

اُذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ يَذْكُرْكُمْ واشْكُرُوهُ يَزِدْكُمْ واسْتَغْفِرُوهُ يَغْفِرْ لكُمْ واتّقُوهُ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَمْرِكُمْ مَخْرَجًا وَأَقِمِ الصّلَاة

title: The Honoring of Humankind
english_text:
The Honoring of Humankind

https://www.khutbah.info/the-honoring-of-humankind/ Ramadan has passed with what the people have done in it. So, there are those who have done well and have gained, there are those who did moderately, and there are those who neglected and have lost. Those who have done well should not be impressed with their deeds, for it is purely Allah's grace upon them. And those who did moderately or neglected, there is still room in what remains of their life for repentance and seeking forgiveness, and an opportunity for action and rectification. Let not Satan overwhelm them with procrastination and delay until their lives end without having made amends. And Allah the Exalted is worshiped and obeyed in Ramadan and outside of Ramadan. And it is befitting for the believer to continue doing righteous deeds.

إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ ,نَحْمَدُهُ ,وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ , وَنَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا ,مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ , وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ , وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ

Verily, all praise is for Allah. We praise Him, we seek His assistance and we ask for His forgiveness. And we seek refuge in Him from the evils of our selves. Whoever Allah guides, none can misguide. Whoever He misguides, none can guide. And I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

يَا أَيُّهَا الّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ آل عمران:102

Al Imran 102 : O you who believe! Fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except in a state of Islam.

إِنَّ أَصْدَقَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ وَأَحْسَنَ الْهَدْيِ هَدْيُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَشَرُّ الْأُمُورِ مُحْدَثَاتُهَا وَكُلُّ مُحْدَثَةٍ بِدْعَةٌ وَكُلُّ بِدْعَةٍ ضَلَالَةٌ وَكُلُّ ضَلَالَةٍ فِي النَّارِ

The truest speech is the Book of Allah and the best guidance is the guidance of Muhammad ﷺ. The most evil matters are the newly introduced, for every newly introduced matter is a Bid'ah (unprecedented matter without basis in Quran or Sunnah). Every Bid'ah is misguidance, and every misguidance is in the Hellfire.

To proceed: Be conscious of Allah the Exalted and obey Him; for it is Allah's the Exalted – instruction to His servants, and the instruction of the messengers to their followers. It is the provision in times of hardship, the escape from difficulties, and salvation on the Day of Resurrection.

وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ-الزُّمَرِ 61

Az-Zumar (39) 61: And Allāh will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

O Muslims:

Allah, the Exalted, created humankind to worship Him. And He the Almighty honored them in a way that He did not honor any other creation. Among the ways that Allah the Exalted honored humankind is that He honored their father, Adam, peace be upon him, by creating him with His own hands and instructed the angels to prostrate to him. So what honor could be greater than this? If only humans reflected about it and comprehended this.

إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ * فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ * فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ * إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ * قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ * قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ * قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ * وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ-ص 71-78

Sad: 71-78: (71) [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay. (72) So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration. (73) So the angels prostrated all of them entirely, (74) Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers. (75) [Allāh] said, O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty? (76) He said, I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay. (77) [Allāh] said, Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled. (78) And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense.

Another honor that Allah the Exalted bestowed upon humankind is making them stewards, owners and builders of the earth.

هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ-فَاطِرٍ 39

Fatir (35) 39: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth.

And from among the ways that Allah Almighty honored humankind is that He subjected what He created to them, although they are bigger and stronger than humans. Allah Almighty said:

هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا-الْبَقَرَةِ 29

Al-Baqarah (2) 29: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth.

And Allah Almighty said:

وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِنْهُ-الْجَاثِيَةِ 13

Al-Jathiyah (45) 13: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth all from Him.

Also, from Allah’s honoring of humans is that He instilled in them the tools of knowledge and understanding, which are the intellect, eyes, and ears. Thus, through them they dominated other creatures.

وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ-النَّحْلِ 78

An-Nahl (16) 78: And Allāh has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect] that perhaps you would be grateful.

Among the honors that Allah Almighty bestowed upon humankind is making them the focal point for His messengers, His books, and His ordainments. For He Almighty sent messengers only to them.

رُسُلًا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى اللَّهِ حُجَّةٌ بَعْدَ الرُّسُلِ-النِّسَاءِ 165

An-Nisa (4) 165: [We sent] messengers as bringers of good tidings and warners so that mankind will have no argument against Allāh after the messengers. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

Allah Almighty revealed books only to them.

وَأَنْزَلَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ * مِنْ قَبْلُ هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ وَأَنْزَلَ الْفُرْقَانَ-آلِ عِمْرَانَ 3-4

Al-Imran (3) 3-4: (3) And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel (4) Before, as guidance for the people. And He revealed the Criterion [i.e., the Qur’ān].

لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا-الْمَائِدَةِ 48

Al-Ma’idah (5) 48: To each of you We prescribed a law and a method.

Allah Almighty honored humankind by exclusively sending them His messengers, Books and Divine laws for their guidance, rectification and happiness in this world and the hereafter.

This Divine preference and honoring of humankind over other creations is encompassed in His Words:

وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِي آدَمَ وَحَمَلْنَاهُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا-الْإِسْرَاءِ 70

Al-Isra (17) 70: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.

In response to this Divine honoring of humankind, people are divided into two groups. A group that accepted it, is honored by it, and is grateful to their Lord for it. So they hastened to worship Him alone without any partners, hastened in servitude to Him and adhered to his religion and established His ordainments. And these people have honor in this world and the Hereafter. In this world, with support, victory and dignity. Allah Almighty said:

وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ-الرُّومِ 47

Ar-Rum (30) 47: And incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.

And Allah Almighty said:

وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ * إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنْصُورُونَ * وَإِنَّ جُنْدَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ-الصَّافَّاتِ 171-173

As-Saffat (37) 171-173: (171) And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers, (172) [That] indeed, they would be those given victory (173) And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.

And Allah Almighty said:

وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ-الْمُنَافِقُونَ 8

Al-Munafiqun (63) 8: And to Allāh belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers

And they will have honor and a great triumph in the Hereafter. Allah Almighty said:

أُولَئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُكْرَمُونَ-الْمَعَارِجِ 35

Al-Ma’arij (70) 35: Those will be in gardens, honored.

And Allah Almighty said:

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ذَلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ-الْبُرُوجِ 11

Al-Buruj (85) 11: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

A permanent bliss and a great dominion. No eye has ever seen it before, no ear has ever heard it before and it is unimaginable to any human heart. Allah Almighty said:

فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ-السَّجْدَةِ 17

As-Sajdah (32) 17: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.

The other group rejected Allah's honoring of them, accepting for themselves humiliation, disgrace, punishment, and debasement. They arrogantly turned away from their Lord, shunned His signs, disdained servitude to Him, rejected obedience to Him, and departed from His guardianship. They followed their desires, obeyed their devils, and neglected their intellects. For them is humiliation, degradation, belittlement, and punishment.

Allah Almighty said:

وَمَنْ يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُكْرِمٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ-الْحَجِّ 18

Al-Hajj (22) 18: And he whom Allāh humiliates for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allāh does what He wills.

And Allah Almighty said:

أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا-الْفُرْقَانِ 44

Al-Furqan (25) 44: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.

And Allah Almighty said:

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أُولَئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ-الْبَيِّنَةِ 6

Al-Bayyinah (98) 6: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.

They disregarded Allah and they disobeyed Him. And had they honored Him, He would have protected them. When a person becomes insignificant to Allah, none will honor them, even if people honor them outwardly due to their need for them or fear of their evil, they are considered the most contemptible and insignificant in their hearts.

Sins have not descended upon places except that they have destroyed them, nor have they entered upon hearts except that they have blinded them, nor have they entered upon bodies except that they have tormented them, nor have they entered upon any community except that they have humiliated them, nor have they entered upon any soul except that they corrupts them. If sins resulted in nothing but causing the person to be insignificant before Allah and falling from His sight, that would be sufficient. When a person becomes insignificant to Allah, none will honor them.

The most honored of creation before Allah are those most conscious Him. The closest to Him in rank are those most obedient to Him. The person's rank before Allah is determined by their obedience.

If a person disobeys Allah, they become insignificant to Him. And this necessitates a rift between servants and their master. When this rift occurs, the channels of goodness are cut off from the person, and the paths of evil are opened to them. What success, hope, or life is there for one whose channels of goodness are severed and who has cut off what is between them and their Master, the Exalted and Glorified?

أَقُولُ مَا تَسْمَعُونَ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ لِي وَلَكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

I say what you have heard and I seek forgiveness from Allah for me and you from every sin. So seek forgives from Him, Verily He is Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

Second Khutbah

الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ, وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ , وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَاْ إِلَهَ إِلَّاْ اَللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَاْشَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَاً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ

All praise is to Allah, and peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah, and I bear witness that there is no deity other than Allah and I bear witness that Mohammad is His slave and messenger.

Anyone desiring honor in this world and the Hereafter, eternal happiness, and salvation from distresses and hardships, should fortify themselves with iman (faith) and righteous deeds, and obedience to their Creator even many others go astray. For the criterion is obedience to Allah, not obedience to humans. True success is when one comes before Allah. Allah Almighty said:

يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ * إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ-الشُّعَرَاءِ 88- 89

Ash-Shu'ara (26) 88-89: (88) The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children (89) But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart.

And there is no security for the heart except in its complete submission to Allah, by following His entire ordainments, without picking and choosing. For selective adherence to the Sharia is the way of those following their whims, who divide their religion, taking from it what they desire and rejecting what they do not desire. Allah Almighty said:

وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَى * فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَى-النَّازِعَاتِ 40-41

An-Nazi'at (79) 40-41: (40) But as for he who feared the position of his Lord1 and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination, (41) Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

Oh Allah, make us among the truly successful; those honored in this world and in the Hereafter. Indeed Allah is All Hearing, Answering.

هَذَا وَصَلُّوا وَسَلِّمُوا عَلَى نَبِيِّكُم كَمَا أَمَرَكُمْ بِذلِكَ رَبُّكُمْ , فَقَالَ

I conclude with this and send prayers of blessings and peace upon your Prophet as your Lord commanded:

إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا

Al Ahzaab (33) 56: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [ Allah to grant him] peace.

اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنا فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنا فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنا فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لنا فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنا شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ وَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ

O Allah, guide us with those whom You have guided, grant us well-being among those You have granted well-being, be an ally to us along with those whom You are an ally to, and bless what You have bestowed upon us, and save us from the evil of what You have decreed. For verily You decree and none can decree over You. He whom You support can never be humiliated. Glory is to You, our Lord, You are Blessed and Exalted.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْنا مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْنا مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَنَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لَنا خَيْرًا

O Allah, We ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what we know and what we do not know. O Allah, we ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet has asked You for, and we seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, we ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and we seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And we ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning us good
